notes.title: Patch: Updated Menus
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Improved readability and navigation on settings and cosmetics menus. Now they should be easier to read, and should be properly navigable when using the controller or keyboard only

Fixed a bug that broke the Mouse Only control style, for all of the three people who use it

Reduced the jitter on title screen backgrounds

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
I rewrote the saving system, but your save data should be automatically migrated to the new system the next time you open the game.

Other changes:

Redesigned the first area: Added water, reflections, terrain, trees, and some other things far off into the distance. Occasionally a group of butterflies will spawn on the stage, and you can chase them away.

Added a visual indicator to the pull teammate effect

Added partial support for ultrawide and portrait aspect ratios

Added a place indicator sign to race mode, though it doesn't track your progress through the level yet

Launching the game for the first time should now automatically set the locale to your native language

Added controller vibrations when you bounce

Added a stage tilt setting

Bugfixes/Tweaks:

Other players in race mode should have nameplates now

In race mode, other players should no longer be invisible or in the wrong spot

Improved the look of triplanar materials, there shouldn't be any ugly blending on curved surfaces now

Altered the raindrops shader in the first environment to be much less performance intensive

The minimap button is no longer double bound to the reverse camera button

Hiding the UI should now properly hide all UI elements

Hiding the UI no longer hides the pause menu

notes.title: Added Localization and Speedrun Timer
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 Added localization to most UI elements.
 Added a speedrun timer to challenge mode, with a cool spinning hourglass animation.
 Removed the time limit from Free Play mode, but the time bonus still works the same.
 Added stickiness to surfaces, which should prevent bouncing off of most curved surfaces.
 Changed the timings on Tornado Alley to be a bit more interesting.

notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Multiplayer stability improvements, hopefully this should help with anyone experiencing random disconnects/crashes.

Patch Notes

 Improved Multiplayer Stability (hopefully!)
 Sped up the intro sequence in multiplayer
 Improved visibility for some UI elements
 Fixed an incorrect menu title (not sure how that got through)
 Fixed an interpolation artifact on HUD elements
